_note: Companies pulled by scripts/fetch-feeds.py before each scheduled scan. /onboard writes your real config/feeds.json from this template. Never add a company your profile excludes.

_how.filters.places: Regex fragments, matched case-insensitively against each role's location. A role whose location matches is kept.
_how.filters.remote_regions: A role marked remote is kept when its location also matches one of these.
_how.filters.target_keywords: A title matching one of these goes to the top table. Every other role in scope is still listed, for renames.
_how.google: location is a place name as Google's careers search takes it; queries are search terms.
_how.jobsyn: Meta's jobs, read through dejobs.org, the job network Meta publishes to. location is a city or country name.
_how.tiktok: city is a city name as TikTok writes it. The script looks up TikTok's own city code itself.
_how.apple: location is Apple's code, country name then ISO code, e.g. united-kingdom-GBR. locale e.g. en-gb.
_how.shopify / etsy: No settings. The script reads the company's whole job list and keeps what matches your places.
_how.greenhouse / ashby / lever / workable /: Set slug to the company's board name, the part after the ATS domain in its job board address.
_how.filters.not_target_keywords: A title matching one of these stays out of the top table even if it hits a target word (e.g. health and safety when you want trust and safety).
_how.filters.exclude: Companies never probed or scanned. Copy the profile's excluded companies here.
_how.discover: Company names only. Each morning the script looks for their public job board and scans it once the board itself states that name. Unsure matches are listed for a hand check.
_how.workday: Companies whose careers site is on myworkdayjobs.com. From an address like https://acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/External: host acme.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com, tenant acme, site External. The script keeps jobs under the site's own location filters that match your places.
_how.amazon: country is the ISO 3-letter code, e.g. IRL or GBR.

_note_discover: Company names to probe for a public Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever or SmartRecruiters board. A board joins the scan only when it states that company's name; unsure ones are listed for a hand check. Vault company folders are probed too. Put excluded companies in filters.exclude so they are never probed.
